title: Measure join aggregation, correlated subqueries and per-parent top-N
acceptance_criteria: Aggregates and top-N have explicit matched empty-set/tie/grain contracts and Go truth checks.
Parent-count/fanout/N sweeps identify measured regimes or unresolved boundaries; supported feature limits are visible.
Generated reports connect cost counters and timings without attributing simultaneous query/index changes to one cause.
expected_artifacts: aggregate/top-N manifests, results, plans and generated reports
validation: Independent Go oracle and firing read-path controls per topology/phase
>=3 whole-run replication and >=3 trials; seeded interleaving and position controls
Plan/cost/result contract audit; resource, client and placement coverage
Containerized queue audit; HIGH review and main ancestry/tag verification
review_policy: HIGH reviews Decision Log, acceptance and evidence; label self-review if no independent reviewer
